name: Wynn's Grain and Spice
old_description: Since 1952, Wynn’s Grain & Spice has remained family-owned and true to its Alabama roots. We remain steadfast to our commitments to quality and to treating our partners like family.
about:
Wynn's Grain & Spice was founded in 1952 in Montgomery, Alabama, and has remained family-owned through three generations. The business began in a home kitchen when a founder known as Wynn, with the backing of a friend, developed a blend of grains and spices that captured Southern flavor. The company still operates from its Alabama base, now in Wetumpka, and continues to honor the original recipes.

The company manufactures a range of dry and liquid products for the foodservice industry, including chicken breadings and batters, marinades and dips, all-natural and conventional seasoning blends, and fryer maintenance chemicals such as Filter Fresh and Fryer Fresh. Production is geared toward wholesale distribution, serving customers across the United States with a focus on prepared chicken programs.

Primary customers are foodservice operators, from independent fried-chicken restaurants to larger institutional kitchens that run prepared chicken programs. The firm positions itself as a consultative partner, offering operational expertise alongside its product line to help clients maximize yield and consistency.

Wynn's emphasizes its family heritage and time-tested formulations as differentiators, stating that its blends are crafted to please discerning palates and that its consultative approach extends beyond simple supply to include fryer management support and program development.

name: Wyoming Building Supply
old_description: When you choose to work with us, you can expect competence, complete transparency, and an overall seamless and stress-free experience. We've been leading the renovation and window installation industry since 1976 and have the experience to prove it.
about:
Wyoming Building Supply has operated in Casper, Wyoming since 1976, establishing a showroom that serves as a hub for home improvement projects across the region. The company began as a renovation and window installation specialist and has expanded its scope over nearly five decades while remaining locally based.

The business provides kitchen installation, bathroom installation, window installation, and door installation, along with full-scale commercial and residential remodeling. It partners with manufacturers to supply windows, doors, countertops, and cabinets through its showroom, and its crews handle on-site measurement, installation, and cleanup. A testimonial references a phased replacement of hundreds of windows for a local multifamily property, indicating capacity for large commercial work.

Customers include both homeowners and contractors, with the website offering separate pathways for each. The company serves the residential remodeling market — kitchens, baths, and whole-home updates — as well as commercial and multifamily property managers seeking energy-efficient window and door upgrades. Concrete examples from reviews include individual kitchen and bath remodels and a multifamily window replacement project involving hundreds of units.

The company emphasizes competence, transparency, and a stress-free experience. Reviews highlight next-day measurement service, precise cabinet measurements, professional crews who clean and wash windows after installation, and transparent invoicing with no surprises. These service differentiators are cited repeatedly by both residential and commercial clients.

name: Xenerpower USA LLC
old_description: Industry-leading design, manufacturing, and distribution of transformers, switchgear, and switchboards — built to the highest standards.
about:
Xenerpower USA LLC is headquartered in Houston, Texas, where it operates a manufacturing facility for power distribution equipment. The company traces its roots back over 30 years in the transformer and switchgear industry, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not stated in public materials.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes a range of transformers—including cast resin, dry-type VPI, pole-mounted, and pad-mounted units—as well as low-voltage switchboards and medium-voltage switchgear. In addition to production, Xenerpower provides repair, refurbishment, and rental services for transformers, along with testing, engineering support, and electrical contracting through its BrightBuild Electric division. The Houston facility serves customers across 48 U.S. states and Canada, with 24/7 technical support and a factory-direct model.

Xenerpower’s equipment is used in urban power grids, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, renewable energy installations, and utility-adjacent infrastructure projects. The company cites a 30-year track record supporting critical power projects for utilities, industrial plants, and commercial developers.

Xenerpower emphasizes an integrated design-build-deliver system to shorten lead times, an in-house engineering team for custom solutions, and 24/7 emergency repair and rental transformer availability. The company positions itself as a factory-direct supplier with testing and certification to IEEE, ANSI, and NETA standards.

name: XtraLight LED Lighting Solutions
old_description: XtraLight is a Houston, Texas-based manufacturer of commercial and industrial LED lighting fixtures operating for over 37 years
about:
XtraLight LED Lighting Solutions is a Houston, Texas-based manufacturer founded in 1986. The company has been producing commercial and industrial LED lighting fixtures for over 37 years, with all engineering, manufacturing, and testing performed at its Houston facility.

The company operates an in-house NVLAP-accredited testing laboratory and offers custom manufacturing capabilities. Its product range spans indoor and outdoor LED fixtures, including high-bay, linear, vapor-tight, hazardous-location, horticultural, and vandal-resistant luminaires, as well as retrofit kits for existing housings. With a workforce of 51 to 200 employees, XtraLight handles design, component sourcing, and assembly internally.

XtraLight serves a broad set of markets: auto dealerships, retail, data centers, food processing, educational facilities, office buildings, hospitality, municipal, street lighting, warehouses, parking garages, and general industrial manufacturing. Recent case studies highlight warehouse installations for a national performance contractor, a large cosmetics distribution center, and a flooring manufacturer distribution center.

The company traces its differentiation to early innovation, such as patenting the first energy-efficient fluorescent high-bay fixture, and emphasizes made-in-America production with Buy American Act compliance. XtraLight also promotes its all-in-house design approach, covering cost analysis, installation planning, and component sourcing.

name: Xtreme Fabrication
old_description: When it comes to metalworking and custom fabrication, Xtreme Fabrication won't leave you disappointed. Xtreme Fabrication is just one call or email away!
about:
Xtreme Fabrication operates from a 30,000-square-foot facility on five acres in Leitchfield, Kentucky. The company employs 20 people and holds ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication, offering MIG, TIG, and stick welding; CNC plasma and laser cutting up to 1-inch thickness; CNC pipe and tube bending up to 2-inch schedule 40 pipe; CNC press brake forming up to 350 tons and 12-foot length; CNC shearing; precision sawing with a Cosen automatic mitering saw; and CNC machining on five centers for runs of one to 4,000 pieces. Additional services include powder coating in what the company describes as the largest oven in central Kentucky, onsite installation, industrial maintenance, and emergency repair.

Xtreme Fabrication serves a range of industrial clients requiring weldment assemblies, complex formed parts, and machined components. The company emphasizes its role as a strategic outsourcing partner for customers needing low- to medium-volume production.

The company says it differentiates itself through a “keen sense of respect” for client time, budget, and needs, competitive pricing, and a quality program backed by a dedicated inspection area with granite surface plates, pin gauges, and 60-inch digital calipers.

name: Xtreme Manufacturing
old_description: Founded in 2003, Xtreme Manufacturing has grown to become one of the leading manufacturers of telehandlers in North America, with an increasing global customer base.
about:
Xtreme Manufacturing is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada. Founded in 2003 by Don Ahern, the company originated from his dissatisfaction with telehandlers available for his rental fleet. After purchasing Western Attachments Company in 1999, an Oregon-based forklift maker, Ahern rebranded it as Xtreme Manufacturing in 2003 and relocated to Nevada.

The company designs and manufactures rough-terrain telescopic handlers (telehandlers) with 24 models spanning lifting capacities from 5,900 to 100,000 pounds and maximum lift heights up to 100 feet. It also produces Xtreme Cubes, a line of portable modular buildings for commercial, residential, and temporary uses. All assembly and engineering operations are conducted at its Henderson facility.

Xtreme serves construction, industrial, oil-and-gas, mining, and rental markets, as well as customers needing modular structures for offices, retail, workforce housing, restaurants, and trade-show booths. Its equipment is sold through a dealer network across North America and increasingly worldwide.

Ahern started the business to build a more reliable telehandler using high-quality components that lower total cost of ownership. The company emphasizes features such as boom rollers instead of wear pads, 360-degree cab visibility, intuitive one-hand controls, and an integrated boom lift point. It backs products with a 10-year/5-year/2-year warranty and notes that all units are built in North America.

name: Yes Solar Solutions
old_description: Since 2009, Yes Solar Solutions has helped North Carolina homeowners go solar with personalized guidance, custom-designed systems, and a smooth installation process from start to finish.
about:
Yes Solar Solutions was founded in 2009 by co-owners Stew and Kathy Miller in Cary, North Carolina. The locally owned and operated firm holds an unlimited North Carolina general contractor's license and an electrical license, allowing it to manage every aspect of solar projects in-house.

The company designs and installs photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial clients, integrates battery storage such as Tesla Powerwall and Duke Energy's PowerPair program, and provides ongoing maintenance, diagnostics, panel inspections, and system upgrades. Its NABCEP-accredited team has completed more than 2,500 installations across the state.

Customers include homeowners, businesses, nonprofits, municipalities, and government agencies throughout North Carolina. Notable projects include a 30.36 kW system for Triangle Family Services and a 101.65 kW installation at Pinehurst Medical Clinic. The firm also assists clients with tax credits, REAP grants, and utility incentive programs.

Yes Solar Solutions distinguishes itself as the only NABCEP-accredited company in the Raleigh area, a credential that reflects rigorous training and ethical standards. The founders' involvement in industry boards and legislative advocacy underscores a mission to make solar simple while maintaining long-term service accountability.

name: Youngtronics, LLC
old_description: Our facility’s two SMT production lines have supported PCB assembly and testing since 2005.
about:
Youngtronics, LLC operates a 6,000-square-foot, climate-controlled facility in Wixom, Michigan. The company moved into the building in 2005 and has run two surface-mount technology (SMT) production lines there since that year. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed publicly.

The shop provides full-spectrum electronic contract manufacturing: PCB assembly using both SMT and through-hole processes (including fine-pitch down to 12 mm, BGA, micro-BGA, and mixed technology), quick-turn prototyping, low- to high-volume production, and turnkey or consignment material programs. Beyond the board, Youngtronics delivers box-build integration, wire-harness and cable fabrication, conformal coating, epoxy potting, and a range of test services—in-circuit, functional, and real-time X-ray inspection. The facility also supports PCB rework, repair, and first-article inspection.

Customers span medical and healthcare, education, transportation, energy and utilities, consumer electronics, defense, telecommunications, automotive, industrial, commercial, and aerospace sectors. The company notes ongoing affiliations with design houses to offer layout and engineering support across those industries.

Youngtronics emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification, on-time delivery, and long-term customer partnerships as differentiators. The business was built to provide cost-effective, high-quality EMS with the flexibility to handle prototypes through full production runs from a single Midwest location.
